data.description: Helvetia Marine – Elegant Homes with Panoramic Gulf Views
data.long_description:
Nestled within Dubai Islands, Helvetia Marine presents a refined coastal lifestyle in a contemporary architectural setting. The building’s smooth silhouette draws inspiration from marine forms, blending harmoniously with its waterfront surroundings.

Interiors are curated with natural textures and soothing tones, creating a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. Select layouts feature private gardens, offering an added layer of exclusivity and outdoor living.

The development is enriched with wellness-focused amenities, including indoor and outdoor gyms, jogging paths, and yoga spaces. Social lounges and relaxation areas provide ideal settings for leisure and connection.
